must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
must_identify.evidence: This invalid directive causes nginx to fail parsing its configuration at startup and exit with code 1, producing the observed `Error`/CrashLoopBackOff state [4, 6, 7].

must_identify.item: The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap
must_identify.evidence: The root cause is confirmed: the `frontend-nginx` ConfigMap contains a typo on line 9 of `default.conf` — `proxy_conect_timeout 2s;` instead of the valid nginx directive `proxy_connect_timeout 2s;` [9].

notes: The RCA correctly names the typo but never quotes or cites the nginx '[emerg] unknown directive' log line, even though it ran the pod logs command; it describes only a generic parse failure with exit code 1. No explicit remediation is recommended; it only rules out a Deployment rollback, so a reviewer may judge whether correcting the directive is clearly implied.

reviewer_ai.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 subagent (AI review, not a person)
reviewer_ai.notes: Disagree with the judge's 'partial'. The pod logs Aurora fetched (step 6) do contain 'nginx: [emerg] unknown directive "proxy_conect_timeout" in /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:9'. The RCA states that this invalid directive makes nginx fail to parse its config at startup and exit 1, which is the same failure, though it never quotes the '[emerg] unknown directive' text. I count the item as met in substance, but it is a close call if exact wording is required. It also wrongly says '1 of 3 desired frontend replicas', when 2 are desired. No fix is proposed; it only rules out a Deployment rollback, correctly.

fix_from_suggestions.reason: Patching the ConfigMap to proxy_connect_timeout and then running a rollout restart of the frontend matches the acceptable fix of correcting the directive and restarting; the restart is listed first, but its own text says it must run after the patch.
